origin.name: OCLP's OpenCore config.plist for MacBookPro9,2, after hao-opencore
origin.note: in the image's EFI partition, not in the System volume; OCLP 3.0.0 writes NVRAM revblock=media (disable_mediaanalysisd), its NVRAM/Delete already lists revblock, and hao-opencore never sets a revblock boot argument

edits.reason: RestrictEvents stops refusing to start mediaanalysisd, so Photos' Live Text gets an answer; media was the only token, so none says nothing is blocked
